description: Private source-reviewed mutants for the public FFF ToolOrdering filament-to-extruder/nozzle routes.

mutants.description: The public non-BBL multi-extruder route must preserve the documented filament-index to extruder-index identity map; collapsing every entry to the master extruder changes the second filament assignment while retaining the first.

The fully-manual public route must accept producer-sized volume/nozzle maps and preserve distinct/shared logical nozzle groups while resolving them to available matching physical nozzles; rejecting the correctly sized volume map yields an empty result before the oracle.
